- make lint passed; make test passed sequentially with 242 tests passed, 16 skipped, and 5 known nextest leak reports already tracked in existing Ralph bug files.
- Committed as dd4bdda (Flatten bdd API test error boundary) and pushed to origin/master.
- Ran bash .ralph/task_switch.sh successfully; it updated Ralph task summaries, sent its email, and again printed a non-fatal rm warning for missing .ralph/current_task.txt.
- Next context should start from the new Ralph task state and can treat the current_task.txt rm message as known non-fatal behavior unless the user asks to fix it.

- Read prior progress log, which was empty for this agent.
- Loaded improve-code-boundaries skill and confirmed it requires checking found_smells before choosing a boundary cleanup.
- Inspected repo status and file layout; next step is to inspect found_smells and pick one smell to finish end-to-end.

- Checked found_smells and found none queued.
- Explored HA boundary candidates; the old PgInfoState-to-PostgresState example is already partly flattened into observe().
- Next I am validating whether HA bootstrap wrappers remain, otherwise I will do a proved single-caller helper inline in HA reconcile/decide.

- Proved `src/ha/reconcile.rs::reconcile_switchover` had a single caller by renaming it and running `make check`; compiler reported exactly one unresolved call in `reconcile()`.
- Inlined the switchover planning match into `reconcile()` and deleted the helper, reducing one fake workflow boundary in HA planning.
- `make check` now passes; next step is the user-requested `make lint` and `make test`, then commit, push, and switch tasks.

- `make lint` passed after the HA boundary cleanup.
- `make test` failed before executing tests: nextest/cargo hit an archive build error under `target/aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu/...rlib` with missing object file `os error 2`.
- Repo policy says log bugs immediately, so next I am creating a bug entry and then checking whether this is a fixable local build-system issue or a real repo defect.

- Re-ran `make test` after the first archive-flake failure; the second run completed successfully with 242 tests passed and 16 skipped.
- This matches the already-filed incremental/nextest build flake in `.ralph/tasks/bugs/bug-make-test-nextest-build-fails-missing-rlib-archive.md`.
- Next I am reviewing the final diff, then committing all requested changes including `.ralph` files, pushing, and switching tasks.
